nodes.label: Multi-Agent Coordination
nodes.summary: Rules for AI agents working concurrently on the repo, each claiming a non-overlapping layer.

nodes.label: scripts/yt-auth.mjs
nodes.summary: One-time OAuth2 flow script that produces a refresh token for headless YouTube uploads.

nodes.label: ui/src (React dashboard)
nodes.summary: React + Vite dashboard source for visual control of config, chapters, builds, and live logs.

nodes.label: Whisper
nodes.summary: Underlying transcription model used for auto-captions (base model on CPU).

nodes.label: googleapis
nodes.summary: Google API client providing YouTube Data API v3 + OAuth2 for uploads.

nodes.label: No Stock Photos / Human Faces
nodes.summary: Visuals must be animated gradients + typography only; no stock photos or human faces.

nodes.label: Single Text Layer Per Scene
nodes.summary: Scene HTML shows visual title only; spoken words live in kinetic captions, never duplicated as body text.

nodes.label: OAuth API, Never Puppeteer
nodes.summary: YouTube uploads must use googleapis Data API v3 + OAuth2; puppeteer-based uploaders are banned.

nodes.label: Never Commit Secrets
nodes.summary: .env, OAuth tokens, and credentials must never be committed to the repo.

nodes.label: scene_base Placeholders
nodes.summary: Do not change scene_base.html structure without updating all chapter JSONs depending on its placeholders.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Multi-agent coordination rules: source-of-truth table, constraints, layer division, and verification commands.

nodes.label: .env
nodes.summary: Gitignored secrets file holding YouTube OAuth client ID, secret, and refresh token.
